description: A People Operations Director must decide whether to launch a six-week peer-feedback pilot for a team whose retrospective meetings have become tense, and must set the pilot's participation, facilitation, feedback, and review safeguards.

shared_context.S1: The product team holds a retrospective every other Friday, and recent sessions have included tense exchanges about how colleagues give feedback.
shared_context.S2: Elena has authority to approve a six-week peer-feedback pilot and define its operating safeguards.
shared_context.S3: The pilot proposal currently describes facilitated discussion, ordinary participation, and a review after the pilot, but does not specify the detailed safeguards.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal approval routine, Elena conducts a round-robin check-in with the project team member and HR program partner before issuing the final plan.

PF1.text: Darius personally observed exactly five dismissive interruptions across the last three retrospectives; two affected colleagues separately told him they would contribute only through an anonymous written channel rather than speak in the group.

PF2.text: Mei confirmed with HR this morning that a peer-feedback pilot following repeated conduct concerns must be opt-in, use an independent neutral facilitator, include a written non-retaliation acknowledgment, and receive a documented review exactly 30 days after launch; the confirmation was not added to the proposal because the HR guidance was issued after the draft circulated.

acceptance_conditions: The peer-feedback pilot must be approved.
The pilot must use facilitated small-group discussion rather than ordinary open discussion.
The record must state exactly five observed dismissive interruptions.
Participation must be opt-in and feedback must include an anonymous written channel.
An independent neutral facilitator must be named.
A written non-retaliation acknowledgment must be committed.
The pilot must have a documented review exactly 30 days after launch.

content_checks.C2: ('facilitated' in decisions['feedback_format'] or 'Facilitated' in decisions['feedback_format']) and ('anonymous written' in decisions['feedback_format'] or 'Anonymous written' in decisions['feedback_format'])
content_checks.C4: (('facilitated' in decisions['feedback_format'] or 'Facilitated' in decisions['feedback_format'] or 'small-group' in decisions['feedback_format'] or 'Small-group' in decisions['feedback_format'] or 'small group' in decisions['feedback_format'] or 'Small group' in decisions['feedback_format']) and ('anonymous' in decisions['feedback_format'] or 'Anonymous' in decisions['feedback_format']) and ('written' in decisions['feedback_format'] or 'Written' in decisions['feedback_format'])) and ('opt-in' in decisions['participation_mode'] or 'Opt-in' in decisions['participation_mode'] or 'opt in' in decisions['participation_mode'] or 'Opt in' in decisions['participation_mode']) and ('anonymous' in decisions['feedback_channel'] or 'Anonymous' in decisions['feedback_channel']) and ('written' in decisions['feedback_channel'] or 'Written' in decisions['feedback_channel'])
content_checks.C5: 'independent neutral facilitator' in decisions['facilitator'] or 'Independent neutral facilitator' in decisions['facilitator']
content_checks.C7: any(('non-retaliation' in c['detail'] or 'Non-retaliation' in c['detail']) and ('acknowledgment' in c['detail'] or 'Acknowledgment' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Darius's observation changes the record from an unspecified concern to exactly 5 interruptions, changes the format to facilitated small groups, and establishes the exact anonymous-written participation channel.
Mei's confirmed HR guidance changes the pilot to opt-in, requires an independent neutral facilitator and written non-retaliation acknowledgment, and fixes the review at exactly 30 days after launch.
